scope: Authorized bounded regression check only; no research-direction adoption

fixtures.tokens_1_to_3: all expert output vectors zero; valid identical routing and gates
fixtures.routing_provenance: constructed synthetic inputs, not captured model traffic

paths.upstream: Unmodified public merge wrapper and Triton kernel, slot order inside each expert-sorted chunk
paths.slot_buffer: Copy every incoming chunk into a full sorted-expert output buffer, then invoke the unchanged public kernel once with original slot order
paths.expert_order: Keep the same sorted expert outputs; reorder inverse-index and gate slots together by expert ID, then invoke unchanged public chunked merge

reference_contracts.slot: CPU scalar FP32 accumulation in original top-k slot order, final FP16 round; full shape/dtype/element-byte equality
reference_contracts.expert: CPU scalar FP32 accumulation in ascending expert-ID order, final FP16 round; full shape/dtype/element-byte equality
reference_contracts.mathematical: Exact Fraction sum of FP16 operands; nearest FP16 selected using exact distances, ties to even
reference_contracts.model_report_tolerance: atol=0.002 rtol=0.002 evaluated only as a descriptive merge-level check; no model or service acceptance conclusion

runs.counter_method: Wrap actual Triton JITFunction.run at launch points and independently count CUDA kernels in profiler trace; no extra merge calls for instrumentation
runs.no_timing_comparison: Cold compile and instrumentation included; record wall/peak for resource accounting only

success: Observe public-option chunk-dependent results and verify the two simple numerical contracts without attributing a quality loss
failure_policy: On mismatch or compile failure stop and investigate only within caps; no changed tolerances or additional fixtures to rescue a result
close_policy: Default output is a small regression and explanation. No research expansion without both a real requirement to preserve the old result and measured unaffordable cost of simple solutions; neither is established at registration.
